name: WA-01
label: Safe D

key_factors: Strong Democratic district with a +15 partisan lean
DelBene's overwhelming financial advantage ($3.55M raised vs. ~$3K)
Incumbency and no competitive polling or ratings suggesting risk
Prediction markets price Democratic win near certainty
model.rationale: The district's +15 Democratic lean, DelBene's incumbency, and a massive fundraising edge over a barely funded challenger all point to a comfortable double-digit win, and markets agree at roughly 97% Democratic. With no polls or expert ratings flagging vulnerability, the fundamentals-based margin stands.
model.watch: Any late polling showing the challenger within single digits, or unexpected outside spending against DelBene, would warrant revisiting.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Suzan DelBene, the Democratic incumbent, is seeking another term in a Seattle-area district that leans Democratic by about 15 points. She advanced to the general election and holds a commanding financial position, having raised roughly $3.55 million with over $1.1 million on hand, while Republican Mary Silva has raised only a few thousand dollars. No outside groups are spending against the incumbent.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings cover this race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, money, and incumbency, all of which favor DelBene heavily. Prediction markets price her win at about 97%, consistent with a Safe Democratic rating and an expected margin in the low-to-mid twenties.
